name: Princess Maker: Yeeon-ui Aideul
source:
[b]Princess Maker: Children of Revelation[/b] is a raising simulation game that returns after 18 years as part of the [b]Princess Maker[/b] package series, where you raise a young girl into adulthood.

While maintaining the charming art style and character development system of the original, it has been reborn as a modern game. 

Become a parent in the game and help fulfill your daughter's dreams!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3438810/Princess_Maker_Children_of_Revelation/]Steam[/url]]
